title: Montgomery
subtitle: Classically inspired, the Montgomery family of seats stands out for its dynamic and contemporary style.
details: Small armchair in ash wood and leather. Removable cover in fabric or leather."Montgomery is a project born from a single detail. The Austrian knot—a type of lacing that characterises Montgomery coats of the ‘80s and ‘90s—was the cornerstone and the focus of the project. The lines of the chair and the small armchair revolve around this detail and recall the collections of some historic designers from the 1970s. We all tend to design chairs that are beautiful when seen from the front, but in reality you normally see a chair from the back because it faces a table in the home. We wanted to lend importance, character and personality to the chair even when it is not being used and is simply being looked at."—Dainelli Studio

title: Montgomery
subtitle: Classically inspired, the Montgomery family of seats stands out for its dynamic and contemporary style.
details: Armchair in ash wood and leather. Removable cover in fabric or leather."Montgomery is a project born from a single detail. The Austrian knot—a type of lacing that characterises Montgomery coats of the ‘80s and ‘90s—was the cornerstone and the focus of the project. The lines of the chair and the small armchair revolve around this detail and recall the collections of some historic designers from the 1970s. We all tend to design chairs that are beautiful when seen from the front, but in reality you normally see a chair from the back because it faces a table in the home. We wanted to lend importance, character and personality to the chair even when it is not being used and is simply being looked at."—Dainelli Studio

title: GRIFFE
subtitle: Stones and shapes framed in wood, daring perspectives, plays of light and hidden preciousness characterise the three Griffe coffee tables. Designers Giorgetti R&D, Giancarlo Bosio 2022
details: Series of coffee or living room tables in different shapes and sizes, made from a clever mix of materials."Griffe is a small family of three low tables, with different cuts and heights, united by a refined combination of joints and layers. Low, jewelled tables that are crafted using special details and materials—wood, leather and marble—designed with absolute visual and constructive simplicity,in the most natural way for a craftsman to put two wooden boards together. The interplay of the joints creates acute and obtuse angles that produce the effect of an unusual and apparently random installation."—Giancarlo Bosio, Giorgetti R&D
